operation.description: create = new PO, update = change an existing PO, delete = delete/cancel a PO, none = not (or no longer) a PO change request.

po_reference.description: Existing PO the user refers to: numeric id or PO number exactly as written (e.g. '123', 'PO-202610-0001'); null for create.

items.description: Materials to order (create) or change (update). Empty for delete.

material_query.description: Material name or SKU as the user wrote it, or the option value they picked.

qty.description: Quantity in the material's unit; null when the user did not say.

supplier_query.description: Supplier code or name if the user named one (or picked one); otherwise null.

needed_by_date.description: Requested delivery date as YYYY-MM-DD, resolved against today; null if not given.

notes.description: Free-text note for the PO if the user gave one.

is_new_request.description: True when the latest message is a new, self-contained PO instruction rather than an answer to / continuation of current_draft.

user_cancelled.description: True when the user says to stop / never mind the pending request.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the interpretation.
